performance.verdict: Organic-only account losing GBP momentum; zero paid activity is the real problem.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both $0 — means 100% of lead generation depends on organic GBP alone.
GBP actions collapsed: last 4 days in series show 0, 0, 0, 0 actions vs. a mid-period peak of 8/day — a confirmed 3-day signal of full stall.
IG reach dropped 40.13% last 7d vs prior 7d; last 3 days averaged 483 vs prior 3-day average of 833 — organic social momentum also fading.
GHL shows 491 contacts and 0 opportunities created in 28 days — intake pipeline is structurally disconnected from any inbound activity.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions daily for 3 more days; if 0 actions persist through 2026-08-22, escalate to profile audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for 4 consecutive days (2026-08-15 through 2026-08-18), down from a mid-period peak of 8/day. Monitor daily through 2026-08-22. If actions remain at 0, trigger a GBP profile audit (completeness, suspension check, category review). Success looks like actions returning above 3/day within the window.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 491 contacts exist but 0 opportunities created — map a contact-to-opportunity trigger or audit the pipeline stage logic.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 491 total contacts against 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window — leads are not becoming pipeline entries. Audit the workflow that should convert contacts to opportunities and confirm stage triggers are active. Success is confirmed when new contacts begin generating opportunity records; re-check by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Watch paid channel re-activation status; zero spend for 28+ days requires client confirmation of intent before any budget moves.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across all 28 days in the window and all 45 days of the daily series. This is not an ads performance issue — paid is fully off. Confirm with client whether reactivation is planned and on what timeline. No budget action can be taken until this is resolved; re-check status by 2026-08-22.
